full_name: Sam Huber | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Journalism & Nonfiction Marilyn Beaudry-Corbett Schlesinger Fellow Yale University
bio: Sam Huber is a writer, editor, and scholar of American literature and feminist thought. At Radcliffe, using collections at the Schlesinger Library, they will research and write a biography of the writer, artist, and activist Kate Millett.
